cast.name: 伊格比·里格尼 Igby Rigney

introduction: Lifelong friends, Josh and Rachel, now teenagers, are keeping secrets from each other. Rachel is in love with Josh as Josh struggles with his sexuality. Rachel impulsively texts Josh her secret, but he doesn't receive it. Instead, Josh finds an anonymous note from a boy he's attracted to. The Viper, a cyberbully, secretly films Josh and Rachel revealing their secrets. The Viper's website outs Josh as gay, so Josh agrees to date Rachel only to prove he's straight. Phoebe, the aspiring journalist, confronts The Viper and exposes his past as a bullied kid. In the end, Josh discovers the courage in himself in this musical film.
